# Authorized Stage 2 Analysis Fixtures

Stage 2 tests generate clicks, silence, and mathematically synthesized
major/minor triads in memory. They contain no human performance, copyrighted
lyrics, or third-party recording. The generated fixtures and reference
annotations are covered by the repository MIT license.

The corpus validates deterministic plumbing, timing, hypothesis contracts, and
evaluation only. It is not evidence of accuracy on commercial recordings or
dense guitar mixes.
